verdict.rationale: Vue's core value is a documented JS API (component options, reactivity, Composition API) with 'world-class documentation' (vue-docs-3), and the llms.txt probe confirms machine-readable docs are exposed for AI consumption (vue-probe-1). However there is no service-style public API (REST/OpenAPI endpoints all 404, vue-probe-2) for programmatic/agentic control beyond using the framework as a library. Missing for 10: an OpenAPI/REST-style control API or explicit agent-facing API docs, and independent evidence of AI agents actually driving Vue apps via this API.
